signupIntent.question: Who will use it?
signupIntent.teamHint: Set up an organization and invite people

roleHints.admin: Everything except transferring or deleting the organization
roleHints.billing: Wallet, invoices and cards — no deployments

onboarding.createSubtitle: Your organization shares one wallet, one set of cards and its deployments. Your personal account stays separate.
onboarding.nameRequired: Enter a name for your organization
onboarding.inviteSubtitle: They'll get an email with a link to join {{team}}. You can invite more people any time.
onboarding.someFailed: Some invitations could not be sent:

invite.title: Join {{team}}
invite.mismatchTitle: This invitation is for a different email
invite.mismatchBody: You're signed in as {{current}}. Sign in as {{email}} to accept it.
invite.invalidBody: Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

closed.REVOKED: It was withdrawn by the organization.
closed.EXPIRED: It has expired. Ask for a new one.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.TEAM_CREATE_BLOCKED: One of your accounts has an unpaid balance over its limit, or a payment under review. Settle it before creating an organization.
errors.TEAM_LIMIT_REACHED: You already own the maximum number of organizations.
errors.INVALID_NAME: Use 2 to 60 characters for the name.
errors.TEAMS_DISABLED: Organizations are not available right now.
errors.INVITE_RATE_LIMIT: Too many invitations today — try again tomorrow.
errors.TOO_MANY_PENDING: Too many invitations are waiting for an answer.
errors.ROLE_ABOVE_YOURS: You can't give a role above your own.
errors.INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation is for a different email.
errors.INVITATION_ACCEPTED: This invitation has already been used.
errors.LIMIT_ONLY_FOR_DEVELOPERS: Spending limits apply to Developers only.
errors.SPEND_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached your monthly spending limit in this team. Ask an owner or admin to raise it.
errors.DEPLOYMENTS_OPEN: Terminate every deployment before closing this organization.
errors.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE: This organization has an unpaid balance. Settle it before closing the account.
errors.BALANCE_REMAINING: There is still credit in the wallet.
errors.TRANSFER_PENDING: A handover is already waiting for an answer. Withdraw it first.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND: This handover is no longer open.
errors.NO_TRANSFER_PENDING: There is no handover waiting for an answer.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_READY: That member’s account is not active and verified.
errors.MEMBER_BLOCKED: That member has an unpaid balance or a payment under review on one of their accounts.
errors.MEMBER_TEAM_LIMIT: That member already owns the maximum number of organizations.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: That person is not a member of this organization.
errors.NOT_A_MEMBER: You are no longer a member of that organization.
errors.OFFER_NO_LONGER_VALID: The person who offered this no longer owns the organization.
errors.OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE: Hand the organization to another member before leaving.
errors.PUBLIC_DOMAIN: That is a public email provider, not a company domain.
errors.DOMAIN_TAKEN: Another organization has already verified that domain.
errors.DNS_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: That TXT record is not visible yet. DNS changes can take a while — try again in a few minutes.
errors.INVALID_JOIN_ROLE: A domain can only let people in as a Developer or a Viewer.
errors.DOMAIN_MISMATCH: That email is not at this organization’s domain.
errors.JOIN_NOT_OPEN: That organization is not taking join requests.
errors.REQUEST_PENDING: You have already asked to join.
errors.REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: That request is no longer open.
errors.TEAM_NOT_FOUND: That organization is not open to domain joins.
errors.NAME_ALREADY_YOURS: You already have an organization with that name.
errors.JOIN_LINK_INVALID: This link is not valid any more.
errors.JOIN_LINK_USED_UP: This link has been used as many times as it was meant to be.
errors.JOIN_LINKS_DISABLED: Join links are not available on this platform.
errors.NO_JOIN_LINK: This organization has no live join link.
errors.DOMAIN_JOIN_DISABLED: Joining by company domain is not available on this platform.

settings.subtitle: Your role: {{role}}
settings.personalOnly: Team settings are for organizations. Switch to one to manage its members.
settings.linkReady: You can also share this link — it only works for the invited email.
settings.removeHint: They lose access right away. Deployments they created stay with the team.

limits.title: {{name}}'s monthly limit
limits.hint: The most this Developer may spend of the team's money each month. Leave it empty for no limit.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Everything that has happened in this organization
activity.member_limitSet: {{actor}} set the monthly limit for {{target}} to {{limit}}
activity.team_discoverabilityChanged: {{actor}} changed whether colleagues can find this organization
activity.domain_joinRuleChanged: {{actor}} changed who the domain lets in
activity.member_joinedByDomain: {{actor}} joined through the company domain as {{role}}

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.hint: The owner answers for what this organization spends. Hand it to a member and you stay on as an admin.
ownership.confirmBody: They have to accept it. Nothing changes until they do, and no money moves either way.
ownership.offeredToYou: {{from}} has offered you ownership of this organization
ownership.whatItMeans: Accepting makes you the owner: you answer for what it spends and for anything it owes. They stay on as an admin.

close.title: Close this organization
close.hint: Everything must be terminated and settled first. Its records are kept; nobody can use it again.
close.confirmBody: Members lose access immediately. The billing history is kept, and this cannot be undone here.
close.balanceTitle: {{amount}} of credit is left in the wallet
close.balanceBody: Closing gives that credit up - it is not refunded. Use it first if you would rather not lose it.
close.confirmForfeit: Close and give up the credit

domain.title: Company domain
domain.hint: Let colleagues at your company domain find this organization. An address at the domain proves nothing on its own — you prove it with a DNS record.
domain.removeHint: Colleagues stop being offered this organization. Everyone already in it stays.
domain.proveBody: Add this record in your DNS, then come back and verify.
domain.dnsSlow: DNS changes can take a few minutes to appear.
domain.joinTitle: When a colleague at this domain signs up
domain.modeHint_off: The domain is on record, but nobody is let in by it.
domain.modeHint_request: They see this organization and can ask. An owner or admin decides.
domain.modeHint_auto: Anyone with a verified address at this domain is in, with no approval. Use it only if your mail admin controls who gets an address.
domain.roleHint: A domain can only let people in as a Developer or a Viewer — neither sees any money.

discover.foundBody: They let people with an {{domain}} address ask to join. An owner or admin will decide.
discover.waiting: Waiting for someone to approve your request.
discover.joinedBody: Your company domain lets colleagues in automatically. You joined as {{role}}.

joinLink.title: Join link
joinLink.hint: One link to share in your own company chat. Opening it does not let anyone in — they ask, and you decide below.
joinLink.reissueHint: Making a new link stops the old one working.
joinLink.copyNow: Copy it now — it is shown only once
joinLink.revokeHint: Anyone still holding it will not be able to use it. Members already in stay.
joinLink.discoverable: Let colleagues at your email domain find this organization
joinLink.discoverableHint: People signing up with an address at your own domain are shown this organization and can ask to join. Off for public email providers.

joinPage.title: Join {{team}}
joinPage.whatHappens: Asking to join sends a request. An owner or admin has to approve it before you get access.
joinPage.signUpHint: No account yet? You can create one on the next screen.
joinPage.askedBody: Someone at {{team}} will approve or decline it. You will be told either way.
joinPage.joinedBody: Switch to it from the account switcher.
